mapper.select: select c.*, json_unquote(json_extract((select e.metadata_json from agent_trace_event e where e.run_id=c.source_run_id and e.event_type='ROUTING_DECIDED' order by e.sequence_no asc,e.occurred_at asc limit 1),'$.routeType')) as route_type, coalesce(c.source_agent_id,r.agent_id) as finding_agent_id,r.latency_ms as source_latency_ms, rv.reviewer as reviewed_by,rv.reviewed_at from eval_case_candidate c left join agent_run r on r.id=c.source_run_id left join eval_case_review rv on rv.id=(select er.id from eval_case_review er where er.candidate_id=c.id order by er.reviewed_at desc,er.id desc limit 1) where c.id=#{candidateId}
select * from eval_case_candidate where source_run_id=#{sourceRunId} and failure_family=#{failureFamily}
mapper.update: update eval_case_candidate set status=#{status} where id=#{candidateId}
mapper.select: select id,candidate_id as candidateId,reviewer,decision,reason,reviewed_at as reviewedAt from eval_case_review where candidate_id=#{candidateId} order by reviewed_at desc,id desc limit 1

select id,candidate_id as candidateId,draft_json as draftJson,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,model_version as modelVersion,created_at as createdAt from eval_case_draft where candidate_id=#{candidateId} order by created_at desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into eval_case_health (case_id,case_version,baseline_reproduced,health_status,summary,updated_at) values (#{caseId},#{caseVersion},#{baselineReproduced},#{healthStatus},#{summary},#{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update baseline_reproduced=values(baseline_reproduced),health_status=values(health_status),summary=values(summary),updated_at=values(updated_at)
mapper.select: select case_id as caseId,case_version as caseVersion,baseline_reproduced as baselineReproduced,health_status as healthStatus,summary,updated_at as updatedAt from eval_case_health health_status=#{status} order by updated_at desc limit #{limit}

select id,status,sampling_policy as samplingPolicy,requested_limit as requestedLimit,sampled_count as sampledCount,analyzed_count as analyzedCount,candidate_count as candidateCount,error_count as errorCount,estimated_cost_usd as estimatedCostUsd,model_version as modelVersion,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,availability_reason as availabilityReason,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from eval_semantic_miner_run where id=#{runId}

select id,status,sampling_policy as samplingPolicy,requested_limit as requestedLimit,sampled_count as sampledCount,analyzed_count as analyzedCount,candidate_count as candidateCount,error_count as errorCount,estimated_cost_usd as estimatedCostUsd,model_version as modelVersion,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,availability_reason as availabilityReason,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from eval_semantic_miner_run order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
